To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the enrichment of thorium with plutonium increases the criticality of the reactor and the time to reach the steady-state regime of the wave nuclear burning.

the enrichment of Th232 fuel by Pu239 increases the WNC criterion, which is determined by the ratio of the neutron flux density to the neutron flux density at which the WNC mode is established in the reactor.
the criterion for the slow WNC of Th232 fuel enriched with Pu239 is fulfilled in the thermal and epi-thermal regions of neutron energies (0,015-10 eВ).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of wave nuclear burning of Th232 with enrichment by Pu239 in the thermal region of neutron energies.

the study of the WNC criterion in the thermal and fast regions of the neutron energy spectrum, which is necessary for the development of wave nuclear power plants (WNP) and wave nuclear power reactors (WNP).
the development of the theory of the dynamics of wave nuclear burning in a thorium-based reactor fuel, enriched with Pu239, and the development of the corresponding numerical model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the WNC mode is possible for thorium fuel with enrichment in Pu239, and its dynamics is determined by the ratio of the neutron flux density of the external neutron source and the thermal parameters of heat removal.
the WNC of the Th232 enriched with 0.5% Pu239 is a promising way to obtain a new generation of wave reactors.
the WNC criterion is satisfied in the thermal and epi-thermal regions, and the WNC mode is possible in the thermal region.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the WNC mode can be achieved in the case of a thorium fuel with an enrichment in Pu239, which allows to obtain the necessary amount of delayed neutrons.

, for a given fuel composition (Th232 + Pu239), the criterion for the fulfillment of WNC can be achieved in the thermal and thermal-epithermal ranges of the neutron energies, depending on the enrichment of Pu239 in the fuel composition.
the WNC of thorium fuel enriched in Pu239 is possible at a neutron flux density of 1012 cm−2 s−1.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the criterion of WNS is fulfilled for a wide range of neutron flux densities and thermal parameters of heat removal, and the WNS mode is stable in the presence of delayed neutrons.
